issue.title: Build Prepare for Offline Screen with Resource Download
issue.body: The resource download section shows the translator what will be downloaded for their selected chapters and lets them start the download. By default, all resources for the selected chapters download automatically; the translator does not configure resources to proceed. Removing individual resources is an opt-in advanced action tucked behind a collapsed control, not the primary path. This ticket builds the resource summary, the running download size counter, the Download button, and the advanced customize control. ## Functional Requirements ### Resource Summary - Display the resource summary below the chapter selection accordion (see #50). - Display a "RESOURCES TO DOWNLOAD" section label above the summary. - Show that all resources for the selected chapters will be downloaded by default; no per-resource action is required to proceed. - Group the resources shown by name (e.g., "Source Bible", "Translation Notes", "Translation Words"), each with its Text and/or Audio items and file sizes. - Treat Tier 1 (source audio, source text, and translation notes) as always included and never removable. - While an item is actively downloading, show a circular progress ring that fills as the download progresses, with a `li:download` arrow centered inside it animating in a slow vertical bounce. - When an item finishes downloading, show a green filled circle (`li:circle-check`) and advance the progress ring to the next item in the download queue. ### Customize Download (Advanced, Opt-In) - Display a collapsed "Customize download" control (`li:sliders-horizontal`) below the resource summary; collapsed by default. - On expand, reveal the Tier 2 and Tier 3 resources as individually deselectable Text and Audio items, each with a selector and file size. - Render Tier 1 items here without a selector; show a `li:lock` icon to indicate they are required and cannot be removed. - Allow the translator to deselect any Tier 2 or Tier 3 item to exclude it from the download. - Reset all removals to the full default set at the start of each new session; overrides do not persist. ### Total Download - Display a "Total download" row below the resource summary showing the cumulative size of everything to be downloaded. - Update the total live if the translator removes items via Customize download. ### Download Button - Display a full-width Download button (`li:download`) below the total download row as the dominant action on the screen. - Label the button with the download size (e.g., "Download 18 MB"), updating if the translator removes items. - For unassigned users, the button is inactive until at least one chapter is selected in the chapter selection accordion. - For assigned users, the button is active by default. - On tap, initiate download in tier order: Tier 1 first, followed by Tier 2 and Tier 3 after Tier 1 completes. - Once download begins, replace the button with Pause, Resume, and Cancel controls (see next ticket). --- ## Engineering context *(Added for implementation readiness. Product requirements above remain the source of truth.)* ### Product intent (summary) Below chapter selection, show what will download (tiered resources + sizes), allow advanced opt-out of Tier 2/3, show live total size, and start download via a primary Download CTA. ### Split (implementation) To keep #51 reviewable, shared **download queue + on-device inventory/worker** is tracked in #201 (sub-issue). This ticket (#51) owns the Prepare for Offline **resources UI**, customize/totals, and Download CTA wiring into that queue. #201 owns persistence, worker, pause/resume/cancel session semantics consumed by #52, and inventory used by #53/#147. ### Proposed technical approach 1. Extend `PrepareForOfflineScreen` beneath `ChapterSelectionAccordion` with a Resources section component. 2. Introduce a **resource catalog + size estimator** service that, given selected chapter ids + project, returns Tier 1/2/3 items (text/audio) with byte sizes. 3. Default selection = all resources; Customize download expands Tier 2/3 deselection (session-only; reset each session). 4. Tier 1 always included (lock icon; not removable). 5. Download CTA enabled per assignment rules; on press, start download **session** in tier order and hand off active controls to #52. 6. Persist queue/progress in local DB or filesystem metadata so #52/#39/#147 can observe the same queue. ### Systems / modules / anchors - Screen: `src/app/screens/PrepareForOfflineScreen.tsx` - Chapter UI: `src/app/prepare-offline/*`, `src/hooks/usePrepareOfflineSelection.ts` - Types: `src/types/prepareOffline/types.ts` (extend) - Preferences/KV: `src/services/storage.ts` - Sync today downloads **API metadata/texts into SQLite**, not tiered media files — new download pipeline required - Filesystem: `expo-file-system` (likely via #94 patterns once available) - API: `src/services/api.ts` — new endpoints as needed for resource manifests/URLs ### Implementation steps 1. Define resource item model (id, tier, kind text|audio, label, bytes, chapter/book scope). 2. Implement catalog builder + size aggregation from selected chapters. 3. Build Resources summary UI + Customize disclosure + Total row + Download button. 4. Implement download session start (enqueue Tier 1 then 2/3; mark #39 download-started). 5. Leave Pause/Resume/Cancel UI to #52; share session state via hook/store. 6. Tests for sizing, tier lock rules, CTA enablement, session reset of customize overrides. ### Dependencies & prerequisites - **In-repo:** #50 (done). Coordinates with #52 (controls), #39 (stop re-surface on download start), #53 (storage inventory of same files). - **External:** fluent-api must provide resource manifests and downloadable URLs/sizes for Source Bible / TN / TW / audio etc. **Blocked** without contract — document assumed shapes in Open questions; do not invent permanent API. - **Assumption:** “Session” = screen mount / app session; overrides do not persist across process death unless product clarifies. ### Edge cases & failure states - Zero chapters selected (unassigned): CTA disabled. - Size unknown: show placeholder / hide misleading totals (define UX). - Partial catalog failure: show error + retry; do not start download. - Overlap with metadata `sync.ts`: resource download is separate from bible_texts sync; avoid double-fetch confusion in UI copy. ### Testing & verification - Unit: tier inclusion, customize deselect math, CTA rules. - Component: resources section rendering + customize expand. - Manual Android: start download transitions toward #52 controls; totals update when deselecting. - Device QA if filesystem writes begin in this ticket. ### Analytics / observability / migrations - May need `download_queue` / `downloaded_resources` tables — design with #52/#53/#147 to avoid thrash. - Log enqueue counts and failures (ids only). ### Assumptions - Resource taxonomy (Tier 1 = source audio/text + translation notes) matches product; exact catalog source is API-driven. - Per-item progress rings described here are completed in #52 if download is mid-flight when leaving the button state. ### Open questions 1. What is the fluent-api contract for listing resources and byte sizes per chapter/project? 2. Are audio/text assets per book, per chapter, or per project? 3. Where are files stored on device (path layout) so #53 can delete “other project” resources? 4. Should Download start work offline on Wi‑Fi-only captive portals, or require server reachability? ### Acceptance criteria - [ ] “RESOURCES TO DOWNLOAD” summary lists grouped resources with text/audio sizes for selected chapters. - [ ] Tier 1 always included and not removable; Customize (collapsed by default) can deselect Tier 2/3 only. - [ ] Customize overrides reset each new session. - [ ] Total download row and button label reflect live size. - [ ] Unassigned: Download disabled until ≥1 chapter selected; assigned: enabled by default. - [ ] Tap Download starts tier-ordered download and yields control surface specified in #52. - [ ] Download start flips #39 “download started” so auto re-surface stops.

comments.body:
@Roslin22 - just checking if an issue was found during QA. I noticed the ticket was moved from QA back to In Progress.

_cc @JonathanSeehagen_

**Test Results for #51 – Prepare for Offline: Resource Download**  

- The Prepare for Offline screen appears when the device regains an active internet connection.
- Assigned chapters can be downloaded successfully by the user.
- All available resources are displayed correctly, including Text and Audio formats. Image resources are displayed in image format.
- Tier 1 resources such as Source Bible and Translation Notes are displayed in a locked state and cannot be deselected or modified.
- Users can customize the download. Tier 2 and Tier 3 resources are displayed correctly, and users can select or deselect the available resources.
- Users can download Tier 1 resources only when optional resources are deselected.
- Users can Pause and Resume downloads while a download is in progress.
- When the user taps Cancel, the download stops successfully.
- If the user navigates back to the project page while a download is in progress and opens another project, the download continues in the background.
- When the internet connection is lost during a download, the download stops.
- UI elements, labels, and text are displayed correctly. The screen is scrollable in both portrait and landscape modes.

**Issues Identified**

- Download button missing: When a project has no assigned chapters, the Download button is not displayed. It should be displayed in a disabled state.
- Download unavailable after chapter switch: After completing a download, when the user selects another chapter/book, the download size updates but the Download button does not appear.
- Deselected resources still download: When a user deselects a Tier 2 or Tier 3 resource, it is still included in the download.
- Manage Downloads text overflow: Text in the Manage Downloads section overflows outside the container.


Moving this ticket to in progress Dev
